about.title: Jorge and the Grace crew
paragraphs: Grace Landscape Maintenance is Jorge's company, licensed with the Oregon CCB (#244900).
We take care of yards week in and week out, and take on bigger jobs too: retaining walls, patios and properties up to 8 acres.
Ask for a maintenance quote and we'll set up a schedule that fits your property.
